title: Where slide-level foundation-model classifiers fail on atypical breast lesions
abstract: arXiv:2611.19630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whether a ductal breast lesion is called atypical hyperplasia or low-grade carcinoma in situ increasingly determines surgery. However, slide-level classifiers built on pathology foundation models (PFMs) perform worst on these lesions. Using four PFMs, cross-validation on BRACS and preregistered hypotheses, we studied where the classification of atypia fails. Because slides are labelled with their most severe lesion, only 39% of the slides with annotated atypical ductal hyperplasia (ADH) were labelled ADH. Attention ranked the lesion high but rarely first, and showing the model only the lesion helped little, whereas classifiers trained per decision with lesion-level labels improved all four atypical boundaries. ADH regions inserted into benign slides raised the probability of malignancy more than that of atypia. translated_title: 切片级基础模型分类器在非典型乳腺病变上的失效之处
translated_abstract: 导管性乳腺病变被诊断为非典型增生还是低级别原位癌，越来越直接决定是否进行手术。然而，基于病理学基础模型（PFMs）构建的切片级分类器恰恰在这些病变上表现最差。我们使用四种病理学基础模型，在BRACS数据集上进行交叉验证并采用预先注册的假设，研究了非典型性分类在何处失效。由于切片是按其最严重病变进行标注的，仅有39%含有非典型导管增生（ADH）标注区域的切片被标记为ADH。注意力机制能将病变区域排到较高位置但很少排到第一位，而只向模型展示病变区域本身帮助甚微；相比之下，使用病变级标签按各个决策分别训练的分类器改善了所有四个非典型性分类边界。将ADH区域插入良性切片中，其使恶性概率的提升大于使非典型概率的提升。在一个由病理医生标注单一亚型切片的医院数据集以及HISTAI数据集中，良性切片的得分更接近病变切片，且……
tldr: 本研究揭示了基于病理学基础模型的切片级分类器在非典型乳腺病变上失效的原因——全切片按最严重病变标注造成的标签噪声以及非典型与恶性之间的判别困难，并证明采用病变级标签按决策分别训练分类器可显著改善所有非典型性分类边界。
en_tdlr: This study reveals why slide-level classifiers built on pathology foundation models fail on atypical breast lesions—due to label noise from labeling slides by their most severe lesion and poor discrimination between atypia and malignancy—and demonstrates that training per-decision classifiers with lesion-level labels improves all four atypical boundaries.
